newsitem.title: USA: MDU Resources to post Q3 $0.13/shr charge.
newsitem.headline: MDU Resources to post Q3 $0.13/shr charge.

text.p: MDU Resources Group Inc said on Tuesday that it will take a $3.7 million, or $0.13 a share charge in the third quarter related to the write down to current market price of natural gas available under a repurchase commitment.
The charge also relates to the reversal of certain reserves for tax and other contingencies, the company said.

"After the effect of the charge, we expect the strong earnings performance of the company this year to largely mitigate the effects of the charge," chief executive H.J. Mellen Jr said in a news release.

The natural resources company said it thinks recognition of the current market value of natural gas located in the Rocky Moutnain region will allow it to market the gas on a sustained basis and allow the company to liquidate the asset over the next four to five years.
The liquidation will save the company annual financing costs, which were about $6 million in 1995, the company said.
